   1 + 3 + 5 + \cdots + (2k-1) + (2(k+1)-1)

   \]
   Thus, the sum of the first \(k+1\) odd numbers is \((k+1)^2\).

Additionally, access to CRISPR-based treatments may exacerbate existing health disparities if only wealthy individuals can afford them.

Ecologically, there is growing concern about the release of genetically modified organisms (GMOs) into the environment. For example, scientists have used CRISPR to create herbicide-resistant crops (Tao et al., 2019) and pest-resistant insects (Cao et al., 2018). While these GMOs could potentially increase food production and reduce pesticide use, they could also have unforeseen ecological impacts if they spread beyond intended areas or interbreed with wild populations.

Overall, CRISPR-Cas9 represents a transformative advance in genetics that will likely have far-reaching consequences across medicine, agriculture, and basic science.
